leftEvidence.title: River and tree of life appear in Eden

points.label: River
points.left: A river goes out of Eden and divides into four heads.
points.right: A river of the water of life flows from God’s throne.

points.label: Tree of life
points.left: The tree of life stands in the middle of the garden.
points.right: The tree of life bears fruit and healing leaves.

points.label: Setting
points.left: The setting is a planted garden with named rivers and regions.
points.right: The setting is a city with throne, servants, nations, and no night.

payload.posture: Notice recognizably shared images without assuming the two settings are identical.

rightEvidence.title: River and tree of life appear in the city

payload.tension: Eden’s river waters a garden with named lands, while Revelation’s river flows from the throne through a city with healing and unending light.
payload.title: Garden river / final river
